messages:
maria: Kicking off eu-central-2 bring-up. Registry replication to the new regional registry is spiking — pushes are stalling, layers queued ~2m each. Any quick wins?

deploy-bot: artifact-sync job 2024-06-18T14:00Z started -> 120 objects queued -> retrying uploads

ahmed: Confirming, on the seed proxies I see NAT gw egress at 95% and lots of TCP retransmits. Small concurrency + single-threaded push could be the bottleneck.

kai: Likely a combination of egress throughput and registry write QPS. The cloud NAT has burst limits; when exceeded packets get queued. We hit that before in ap-south bring-ups.

sylvie: Quick workaround: reduce push concurrency from 16 -> 4 and parallelize by manifest group. Also start an in-region pre-warm pull farm to prime layers instead of pushing everything. Lower egress bursts that way.

ahmed: +1. Also enable HTTP/2 on the registry endpoint if it's supported — fewer connections, better multiplexing.

maria: Can someone run a smoke to confirm throughput cap? Use the small test job:

```
# run from seed-proxy-1
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/test/image-layer-1 --region eu-central-2 /tmp/layer1 --no-progress
curl -I https://registry-eu-central-2.redwood.internal/health
```

kai: Ran it: GET /health is 200 but pushes still 40-60s per 10MB layer. With NAT metrics, egress p95 ~350Mbps, quota is 400Mbps. We're bumping against limit.

ops-runbooks-bot: Note added to infra-runbooks: "registry-priming: verify NAT headroom before full replication"

sylvie: For long-term fix: request higher NAT bandwidth or add regional egress gateway, and tweak artifact-replication to do manifest-first then concurrent pulls. Also add checksum-style validation to avoid re-pushing already-present layers.

jen: Cost note — cross-region pulls cost egress on primary region. Pre-warm via small cache nodes in eu-central-2 that pull from primary during off-peak reduces peak egress and spreads cost, though total bytes are same. Might reduce transient burst charges.

maria: Action items: 1) Ahmed to throttle replication concurrency to 4 and start 5 cache-nodes in eu-central-2 to prime top 50 images (eta 30m). 2) Kai to open NAT increase ticket with cloud infra and add to runbook. 3) Sylvie to add manifest-first flag to replication tool and a checksum check. 4) Ops-runbooks-bot to append validation step: "registry push p50 < 20s for 10MB layer".

ahmed: On it. Starting the throttle now, will post logs.

maria: Thanks — once cache-nodes report healthy pulls we'll re-run helm sync for core control plane and mark registry replication green.

jen: ping me after runs, I'll include cost impact in the region onboarding spreadsheet.

maria: updating runbook & will post a short handoff doc in #eng-infra-handovers when done. :white_check_mark:
